limitations.map_scope: Actual pathname/inode/content-pinned runtime evidence, not a hash of live mapped memory or universal overlay-backing proof.
limitations.mechanism_scope: Observed policy getter plus positive cache uploads/H2D and frozen source binding; earlier Nsight mechanism evidence is separate, not an HTTP direct-call count.

metric_definitions.admission_latency: Same content/terminal endpoints minus request journal admission.monotonic.
metric_definitions.independent_unit: PAIR, with exactly two pairs per read schedule; schedule aggregate is median of two paired ratios, not a pooled request statistic.
metric_definitions.native_ttft_seconds: First nonempty client content event minus client sent_at; not first GPU-token latency.
metric_definitions.phase_W: First measured client_dispatch_at to last measured client terminal ended_at; includes inter-request gaps and failures.
metric_definitions.phase_qualified_goodput: Reference-qualified measured completion tokens / phase W, only when the entire lifecycle and pair qualify.
metric_definitions.serialized_service_rate: 40 / sum of five measured native E2E values; request-only service-normalized rate, NOT phase-W goodput.

source_identity.scope: New 728df96 orchestration/provenance only; accepted c3db CLI remains compiled production d8c92d8 / archive37b2f40, without rebuild or relabeling.

timing.limitation: Actual authenticated entries passed the unchanged budgets; standalone pre-spawn live-hash timings and exact supervisor-entry stamps are unobserved. CPU proxy timings are not substituted.
timing.source: Recorded receipt/event monotonic and unix timestamps, never file mtimes. Worker first_observed_at is an observation, not an exact spawn timestamp.
